                Ok(h) => h.trim().to_string(),
                Err(_) => {
                    eprintln!("error: patch `{}` does not exist", rev);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
    };
    // Find patch name for oid
    for (name, meta) in &stack.patches {
        if meta.oid == target_oid {
            if showbranch {
                println!("{}:{}", branch, name);
            } else {
                println!("{}", name);
            }
            return;
        }
    }
    // If oid is HEAD and no patch matches, maybe it's base? Then error?
    eprintln!("error: patch `{}` does not exist", rev);
    std::process::exit(1);
}

fn do_diff(path: Vec<String>, range: Option<String>, stat: bool, diff_opt: Vec<String>) {
    // stg diff: Show diff between worktree and HEAD or between revisions
    // Simplified: if range provided, do git diff between those revisions (resolved via id)
    // If no range, show diff between HEAD and worktree (or index)
    if let Some(r) = range {
        // Parse range like rev1..rev2 or rev1.. rev2 or single rev
        // For simplicity, if contains "..", split
        if r.contains("..") {
            let parts: Vec<&str> = r.split("..").collect();
            let rev1 = parts[0];
            let rev2 = if parts.len()>1 { parts[1] } else { "" };
            let mut args = vec!["diff"];
            if stat { args.push("--stat"); }
            for opt in &diff_opt {
                args.push(opt);
            }
            // Resolve revs via id? Use git rev-parse? We'll try to resolve via our id logic using git rev-parse directly for now
            let rev1_resolved = match resolve_rev_for_diff(rev1) {
                Some(h) => h,
                None => rev1.to_string(),
            };
            if rev2.is_empty() {
                args.push(&rev1_resolved);
                // add paths
                if !path.is_empty() {
                    args.push("--");
                    for p in &path { args.push(p); }
                }
            } else {
                let rev2_resolved = match resolve_rev_for_diff(rev2) {
                    Some(h) => h,
                    None => rev2.to_string(),
                };
                args.push(&rev1_resolved);
                args.push(&rev2_resolved);
                if !path.is_empty() {
                    args.push("--");
                    for p in &path { args.push(p); }
                }
            }
            let _ = Command::new("git").args(&args).status();
        } else {
            // single rev: diff between rev and worktree? Or HEAD? Original says defaulting to HEAD. If range is single rev, show diff between that rev and worktree? Actually spec: Show diff between working copy or tree-ish and another tree-ish defaulting to HEAD.
            let rev_resolved = resolve_rev_for_diff(&r).unwrap_or_else(|| r.clone());
            let mut args = vec!["diff"];
            if stat { args.push("--stat"); }
            for opt in &diff_opt {
                args.push(opt);
            }
            args.push(&rev_resolved);
            if !path.is_empty() {
                args.push("--");
                for p in &path { args.push(p); }
            }
            let _ = Command::new("git").args(&args).status();
        }
    } else {
        // No range: diff HEAD vs worktree
        let mut args = vec!["diff"];
        if stat { args.push("--stat"); }
        for opt in &diff_opt {
            args.push(opt);
        }
        args.push("HEAD");
        if !path.is_empty() {
            args.push("--");
            for p in &path { args.push(p); }
        }
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(&args).status();
    }
}

fn resolve_rev_for_diff(rev: &str) -> Option<String> {
    if rev.is_empty() { return None; }
    // Try to resolve via stg id logic
    // For simplicity, try patch name
    let branch = get_current_branch().ok()?;
    if !stack_ref_exists(&branch) { return None; }
    let (stack, _, _) = read_stack_json(&branch).ok()?;
    if let Some(meta) = stack.patches.get(rev) {
        return Some(meta.oid.clone());
    }
    if rev == "{base}" {
        return get_base_commit(&stack, &branch).ok();
    }
    // Try git rev-parse
    if let Ok(out) = run_git_output(&["rev-parse", rev]) {
        return Some(out.trim().to_string());
    }
    None
}

fn do_files(revision: Option<String>, stat: bool, branch_opt: Option<String>) {
    let branch = branch_opt.unwrap_or_else(|| get_current_branch().unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }));
    if !stack_ref_exists(&branch) {
        eprintln!("error: no patches applied");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let (stack, _, _) = read_stack_json(&branch).unwrap();
    let target_rev = revision.unwrap_or_else(|| {
        if let Some(top) = stack.applied.last() {
            stack.patches.get(top).unwrap().oid.clone()
        } else {
            eprintln!("error: no patches applied");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    });
    // Resolve target_rev to commit oid
    let commit_oid = if let Some(meta) = stack.patches.get(&target_rev) {
        meta.oid.clone()
    } else {
        // try as patch name or git rev
        match run_git_output(&["rev-parse", &target_rev]) {
            Ok(h) => h.trim().to_string(),
            Err(_) => {
                eprintln!("error: patch `{}` does not exist", target_rev);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    };
    // Get parent
    let parent = run_git_output(&["log", "-1", "--pretty=%P", &commit_oid]).unwrap_or_default().trim().split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or("").to_string();
    if parent.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let args = if stat {
        vec!["diff", "--name-status", &parent, &commit_oid]
    } else {
        // files changed
        vec!["diff", "--name-only", &parent, &commit_oid]
    };
    let _ = Command::new("git").args(&args).status();
}

fn do_show(patch_or_rev: Vec<String>, patch_opt: Vec<String>, branch_opt: Option<String>, stat: bool, diff_opt: Vec<String>, applied: bool, unapplied: bool, hidden: bool) {
    let branch = branch_opt.unwrap_or_else(|| get_current_branch().unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }));
    if !stack_ref_exists(&branch) {
        eprintln!("error: no patches applied");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let (stack, _, _) = read_stack_json(&branch).unwrap();
    let mut revs: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    if !patch_or_rev.is_empty() {
        revs.extend(patch_or_rev);
    }
    if !patch_opt.is_empty() {
        revs.extend(patch_opt);
    }
    if revs.is_empty() {
        // If no rev, show applied, unapplied, hidden selection?
        if applied {
            for name in &stack.applied {
                revs.push(name.clone());
            }
        } else if unapplied {
            for name in &stack.unapplied {
                revs.push(name.clone());
            }
        } else if hidden {
            for name in &stack.hidden {
                revs.push(name.clone());
            }
        } else {
            // default top
            if let Some(top) = stack.applied.last() {
                revs.push(top.clone());
            } else {
                eprintln!("error: no patches applied");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    }

    // For each rev, handle ranges like begin..end
    let mut expanded: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for r in revs {
        if r.contains("..") {
            let parts: Vec<&str> = r.split("..").collect();
            let begin = parts[0];
            let end = parts[1];
            // Find indexes in series
            let all_patches: Vec<String> = {
                let mut v = stack.applied.clone();
                v.extend(stack.unapplied.clone());
                v.extend(stack.hidden.clone());
                v
            };
            let begin_idx = if begin.is_empty() { 0 } else { all_patches.iter().position(|x| x==begin).unwrap_or(0) };
            let end_idx = if end.is_empty() { all_patches.len()-1 } else { all_patches.iter().position(|x| x==end).unwrap_or(all_patches.len()-1) };
            for idx in begin_idx..=end_idx {
                expanded.push(all_patches[idx].clone());
            }
        } else {
            expanded.push(r);
        }
    }

    for rev in expanded {
        // Resolve to commit
        let commit_oid = if let Some(meta) = stack.patches.get(&rev) {
            meta.oid.clone()
        } else {
            match run_git_output(&["rev-parse", &rev]) {
                Ok(h) => h.trim().to_string(),
                Err(_) => {
                    eprintln!("error: patch `{}` does not exist", rev);
                    continue;
                }
            }
        };
        let mut args = vec!["show"];
        if stat {
            args.push("--stat");
        }
        for opt in &diff_opt {
            args.push(opt);
        }
        args.push(&commit_oid);
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(&args).status();
    }
}

fn do_branch(branch_arg: Option<String>, list: bool, create: Option<String>, clone_opt: Option<Option<String>>, rename: Option<String>, protect: Option<Option<String>>, unprotect: Option<Option<String>>, delete: Option<Option<String>>, cleanup: Option<Option<String>>, describe: Option<String>, merge: bool, force: bool, extra: Vec<String>) {
    if list {
        // list branches
        // git branch list
        // Need to show stgit status: ">" for current, "s" for stgit?
        // Original branch --list output: "> s \tmaster  |" ?
        // Let's mimic: each line shows branch name with markers
        let out = run_git_output(&["branch", "--list"]).unwrap_or_default();
        let current = get_current_branch().unwrap_or_default();
        for line in out.lines() {
            let clean = line.trim().trim_start_matches("* ").trim();
            let is_current = line.contains("*");
            // Check if stacks ref exists
            let has_stack = stack_ref_exists(clean);
            let marker = if has_stack { "s" } else { " " };
            if is_current {
                println!("> {} \t{}  |", marker, clean);
            } else {
                println!("  {} \t{}  |", marker, clean);
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    if let Some(new_branch) = create {
        // create and switch
        // new_branch may be first arg, extra may contain committish
        let committish = if !extra.is_empty() { extra[0].clone() } else { "HEAD".to_string() };
        // git branch new_branch committish
        let status = Command::new("git").args(&["branch", &new_branch, &committish]).status().unwrap();
        if !status.success() {
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        // init stack on new branch if not exists? Original says branches created with stg branch --create are automatically initialized
        // So init stack for new branch
        // Checkout new branch
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["checkout", &new_branch]).status();
        if !stack_ref_exists(&new_branch) {
            do_init(Some(new_branch.clone()));
        }
        return;
    }
    if let Some(clone_val) = clone_opt {
        let new_branch_name = match clone_val {
            Some(Some(name)) => name,
            Some(None) => {
                // clone with timestamp? Use current branch name with timestamp
                let cur = get_current_branch().unwrap();
                format!("{}-clone-{}", cur, chrono::Utc::now().timestamp())
            },
            None => {
                // No value provided? Use timestamp
                let cur = get_current_branch().unwrap();
                format!("{}-clone-{}", cur, chrono::Utc::now().timestamp())
            }
        };
        // clone current branch: create new branch at same commit and copy stacks
        let cur_branch = get_current_branch().unwrap();
        let cur_head = get_current_head_commit().unwrap();
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["branch", &new_branch_name, &cur_head]).status();
        // Copy stacks ref
        if stack_ref_exists(&cur_branch) {
            let tip = get_stack_tip_commit(&cur_branch).unwrap();
            let new_ref = format!("refs/stacks/{}", new_branch_name);
            let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["update-ref", &new_ref, &tip]).status();
            // Also copy patches refs?
            let out = run_git_output(&["show-ref"]).unwrap_or_default();
            for line in out.lines() {
                if line.contains(&format!("refs/patches/{}/", cur_branch)) {
                    let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
                    if parts.len()==2 {
                        let hash = parts[0];
                        let refname = parts[1];
                        let new_refname = refname.replace(&format!("refs/patches/{}/", cur_branch), &format!("refs/patches/{}/", new_branch_name));
                        let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["update-ref", &new_refname, hash]).status();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // checkout new branch
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["checkout", &new_branch_name]).status();
        return;
    }
    if let Some(del) = delete {
        let branch_to_del = match del {
            Some(name) => name,
            None => {
                if let Some(b) = branch_arg.clone() {
                    b
                } else {
                    eprintln!("error: branch name required");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        };
        let mut args = vec!["branch", "-D"];
        if force {
            args = vec!["branch", "-D"];
        } else {
            args = vec!["branch", "-d"];
        }
        args.push(&branch_to_del);
        let status = Command::new("git").args(&args).status().unwrap();
        if !status.success() {
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        // delete stacks ref
        let refname = format!("refs/stacks/{}", branch_to_del);
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["update-ref", "-d", &refname]).status();
        return;
    }
    if let Some(_) = cleanup {
        // remove stack
        let branch_to_clean = cleanup.unwrap_or_else(|| Some(get_current_branch().unwrap())).unwrap_or_else(|| get_current_branch().unwrap());
        let refname = format!("refs/stacks/{}", branch_to_clean);
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["update-ref", "-d", &refname]).status();
        return;
    }
    if let Some(br) = branch_arg {
        // switch to branch
        let status = Command::new("git").args(&["checkout", &br]).status().unwrap();
        if !status.success() {
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        println!("{}", br);
        return;
    }
    // No args: print current branch
    let cur = get_current_branch().unwrap();
    println!("{}", cur);
}

fn do_export(patch: Vec<String>, branch_opt: Option<String>, dir_opt: Option<String>, patch_suffix: bool, extension: Option<String>, numbered: bool, template: Option<String>, stdout_flag: bool, diff_opt: Vec<String>) {
    let branch = branch_opt.unwrap_or_else(|| get_current_branch().unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }));
    if !stack_ref_exists(&branch) {
        return;
    }
    let (stack, _, _) = read_stack_json(&branch).unwrap();
    let patches_to_export: Vec<String> = if patch.is_empty() {
        let mut v = stack.applied.clone();
        v.extend(stack.unapplied.clone());
        v
    } else {
        // handle ranges
        let mut expanded = Vec::new();
        for p in patch {
            if p.contains("..") {
                let parts: Vec<&str> = p.split("..").collect();
                let begin = parts[0];
                let end = parts[1];
                let all: Vec<String> = {
                    let mut v = stack.applied.clone();
                    v.extend(stack.unapplied.clone());
                    v
                };
                let b_idx = all.iter().position(|x| x==begin).unwrap_or(0);
                let e_idx = all.iter().position(|x| x==end).unwrap_or(all.len()-1);
                for idx in b_idx..=e_idx {
                    expanded.push(all[idx].clone());
                }
            } else {
                expanded.push(p);
            }
        }
        expanded
    };

    let out_dir = dir_opt.unwrap_or_else(|| "patches-".to_string() + &branch);
    if !stdout_flag {
        let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&out_dir);
    }

    // Write series file
    if !stdout_flag {
        let series_path = Path::new(&out_dir).join("series");
        let mut series_content = String::new();
        for (i, pname) in patches_to_export.iter().enumerate() {
            let filename = if numbered {
                format!("{:02}-{}", i+1, pname)
            } else {
                pname.clone()
            };
            let suffix = if patch_suffix {
                ".patch"
            } else if let Some(ext) = &extension {
                &format!(".{}", ext)
            } else {
                ""
            };
            series_content.push_str(&format!("{}{}\n", filename, suffix));
        }
        let _ = fs::write(series_path, series_content);
    }

    for (i, pname) in patches_to_export.iter().enumerate() {
        let oid = match stack.patches.get(pname) {
            Some(m) => m.oid.clone(),
            None => continue,
        };
        // Get commit diff
        let parent = run_git_output(&["log", "-1", "--pretty=%P", &oid]).unwrap_or_default().trim().split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or("").to_string();
        let diff_output = if parent.is_empty() {
            run_git_output(&["show", "--pretty=format:%B", &oid]).unwrap_or_default()
        } else {
            // Generate patch format: use git format-patch --stdout?
            // Simplified: git show
            run_git_output(&["show", &oid]).unwrap_or_default()
        };
        // For export, original generates files with commit message and diff
        // Let's use git format-patch style: commit message plus diff
        let content = run_git_output(&["show", &oid]).unwrap_or_default();

        if stdout_flag {
            println!("{}", content);
        } else {
            let filename = if numbered {
                format!("{:02}-{}", i+1, pname)
            } else {
                pname.clone()
            };
            let suffix = if patch_suffix {
                ".patch".to_string()
            } else if let Some(ext) = &extension {
                format!(".{}", ext)
            } else {
                "".to_string()
            };
            let filepath = Path::new(&out_dir).join(format!("{}{}", filename, suffix));
            let _ = fs::write(filepath, content);
        }
    }
}

fn do_patches(path: Vec<String>, branch_opt: Option<String>, diff_flag: bool, diff_opt: Vec<String>) {
    let branch = branch_opt.unwrap_or_else(|| get_current_branch().unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }));
    if !stack_ref_exists(&branch) {
        return;
    }
    let (stack, _, _) = read_stack_json(&branch).unwrap();
    // If no path given, use files modified in working tree
    let target_paths: Vec<String> = if path.is_empty() {
        // git diff --name-only HEAD
        let out = run_git_output(&["diff", "--name-only", "HEAD"]).unwrap_or_default();
        out.lines().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect()
    } else {
        path.clone()
    };

    // For each applied patch, check if it modifies any of target_paths
    for pname in &stack.applied {
        let oid = stack.patches.get(pname).unwrap().oid.clone();
        let parent = run_git_output(&["log", "-1", "--pretty=%P", &oid]).unwrap_or_default().trim().split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or("").to_string();
        if parent.is_empty() { continue; }
        // git diff --name-only parent oid
        let out = run_git_output(&["diff", "--name-only", &parent, &oid]).unwrap_or_default();
        let modified_files: Vec<String> = out.lines().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
        if target_paths.iter().any(|tp| modified_files.contains(tp)) {
            if diff_flag {
                let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["show", &oid]).status();
            } else {
                println!("{}", pname);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn do_undo(number: Option<usize>, hard: bool) {
    let branch = get_current_branch().unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); });
    if !stack_ref_exists(&branch) {
        eprintln!("error: no undo information");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let (stack, tip, _) = read_stack_json(&branch).unwrap();
    let count = number.unwrap_or(1);
    let mut current = Some(tip.clone());
    let mut target_stack: Option<StackJson> = None;
    let mut target_tip: Option<String> = None;
    for _ in 0..count {
        if let Some(commit) = current.clone() {
            // get prev
            let parents_out = run_git_output(&["log", "-1", "--pretty=%P", &commit]).unwrap_or_default();
            let parents: Vec<String> = parents_out.trim().split_whitespace().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
            if parents.is_empty() { break; }
            let meta_commit = &parents[0];
            let ls = run_git_output(&["ls-tree", meta_commit]).unwrap_or_default();
            let mut blob_oid = None;
            for line in ls.lines() {
                if line.contains("stack.json") {
                    let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
                    if parts.len()>=3 { blob_oid = Some(parts[2].to_string()); }
                }
            }
            if let Some(oid) = blob_oid {
                let content = run_git_output(&["cat-file", "-p", &oid]).unwrap_or_default();
                if let Ok(sj) = serde_json::from_str::<StackJson>(&content) {
                    if let Some(prev) = sj.prev.clone() {
                        target_tip = Some(prev.clone());
                        // Need to read prev's stack.json
                        let prev_parents_out = run_git_output(&["log", "-1", "--pretty=%P", &prev]).unwrap_or_default();
                        let prev_parents: Vec<String> = prev_parents_out.trim().split_whitespace().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
                        if !prev_parents.is_empty() {
                            let prev_meta = &prev_parents[0];
                            let ls2 = run_git_output(&["ls-tree", prev_meta]).unwrap_or_default();
                            let mut blob2 = None;
                            for line in ls2.lines() {
                                if line.contains("stack.json") {
                                    let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
                                    if parts.len()>=3 { blob2 = Some(parts[2].to_string()); }
                                }
                            }
                            if let Some(oid2) = blob2 {
                                let content2 = run_git_output(&["cat-file", "-p", &oid2]).unwrap_or_default();
                                if let Ok(sj2) = serde_json::from_str::<StackJson>(&content2) {
                                    target_stack = Some(sj2);
                                    current = Some(prev);
                                    continue;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        current = sj.prev;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if let (Some(ts), Some(tt)) = (target_stack, target_tip) {
        // Restore stack to target
        let branch_ref = format!("refs/heads/{}", branch);
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["update-ref", &branch_ref, &ts.head]).status();
        if hard {
            let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["reset", "--hard", &ts.head]).status();
        } else {
            let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["reset", "--mixed", &ts.head]).status();
        }
        let refname = format!("refs/stacks/{}", branch);
        // Need to create new stacks commit pointing to target? Actually undo should move refs/stacks to target tip
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(&["update-ref", &refname, &tt]).status();
        // Print new top?
        if let Some(top) = ts.applied.last() {
            println!("> {}", top);
        }
    } else {
        eprintln!("error: no undo information");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn do_redo(number: Option<usize>, hard: bool) {
    // redo undoes undo: need to track undo stack? We don't track redo info separately, but we can attempt to find next commit in reflog? For simplicity, we don't support redo fully.
    // We can try to look at reflog of refs/stacks ?

    std::process::exit(1);
}

fn main() {
    let cli = Cli::parse();
    // Handle -C options
    let mut cwd = std::env::current_dir().unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from("."));
    for p in &cli.c_path {
        let new_path = if p.is_absolute() { p.clone() } else { cwd.join(p) };
        cwd = new_path;
    }
    if !cli.c_path.is_empty() {
        if let Err(_) = std::env::set_current_dir(&cwd) {
            // ignore?
        }
    }

    let color_mode = cli.color.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "auto".to_string());

    if cli.version_flag {
        print_version(false, &color_mode);
        return;
    }

    match cli.command {
        None => {
            // print main help
            let mut cmd = ClapCommand::new("stg")
                .about("Maintain a stack of patches on top of a Git branch.")
                .styles(get_styles())
                .disable_help_flag(true)
                .disable_version_flag(true)
                .arg(Arg::new("version").long("version").help("Print version information").action(clap::ArgAction::SetTrue))
                .arg(Arg::new("C").short('C').value_name("path").help("Run as if stg was started in '<path>' instead of the current working directory. When multiple `-C` options are given, each subsequent non-absolute `-C <path>` is interpreted relative to the preceding `-C <path>`.\n\nThis option affects arguments that expect path names or path specs in that their interpretations of the path names would be made relative to the working directory caused by the `-C` option.").action(clap::ArgAction::Append))
                .arg(Arg::new("color").long("color").value_name("when").help("Specify when to colorize the output.\n\n`auto` (the default) enables colored output only when outputting to a terminal or TTY. The `NO_COLOR` environment variable is respected.\n\n`always` and `never` unconditionlly enable/disable colored output, respectively.\n\n`ansi` forces color to be output using ANSI escape sequences, even in a Windows console."))
                .arg(Arg::new("help").short('h').long("help").help("Print help (see a summary with '-h')").action(clap::ArgAction::Help));
            // add subcommands manually for help text? clap Parser will generate.
            // To exactly match original help, we need to replicate original's help output.
            // For simplicity, just use Cli::command()...
            // But we haven't defined all subcommands listing in main help.
            // Let's just call original clap help generation via Cli.
            let mut cli_cmd = Cli::command();
            let _ = cli_cmd.print_help();
            println!();
            return;
        }
        Some(cmd) => {
            handle_command(cmd, &color_mode, cli.c_path.clone());
        }
    }
}

fn handle_command(cmd: Commands, global_color: &str, c_paths: Vec<PathBuf>) {
    match cmd {
        Commands::Version { short, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            print_version(short, cm);
        }
        Commands::Init { branch, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_init(branch);
        }
        Commands::Series { patch, branch, color, all, short, applied, unapplied, hidden, missing, author, count, commit_id, description, empty, reverse, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            do_series(patch, branch, cm, all, short, applied, unapplied, hidden, missing, author, count, commit_id, description, empty, reverse);
        }
        Commands::New { patchname, path, name, color, refresh, index, force, message, file, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_new(patchname, path, name, refresh, index, force, message, file);
        }
        Commands::Refresh { path, color, index, force, patch, message, file, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_refresh(path, index, force, patch, message, file);
        }
        Commands::Pop { patch, all, number, spill, keep, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_pop(patch, all, number, spill, keep);
        }
        Commands::Push { patch, all, number, reverse, noapply, set_tree, keep, merged, committer_date_is_author_date, conflicts, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_push(patch, all, number, reverse, noapply, set_tree, keep);
        }
        Commands::Top { color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            do_top(cm);
        }
        Commands::Next { color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            do_next(cm);
        }
        Commands::Prev { color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            do_prev(cm);
        }
        Commands::Id { revision, branch, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_id(revision, branch);
        }
        Commands::Name { revision, branch, showbranch, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_name(revision, branch, showbranch);
        }
        Commands::Diff { path, range, stat, diff_opt, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_diff(path, range, stat, diff_opt);
        }
        Commands::Files { revision, color, stat, branch, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_files(revision, stat, branch);
        }
        Commands::Show { patch_or_rev, patch, branch, stat, diff_opt, color, applied, unapplied, hidden, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_show(patch_or_rev, patch, branch, stat, diff_opt, applied, unapplied, hidden);
        }
        Commands::Log { patch, branch, diff, number, full, graphical, clear, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_log(patch, branch, diff, number, full, graphical, clear);
        }
        Commands::Branch { branch, list, create, clone, rename, protect, unprotect, delete, cleanup, describe, merge, force, color, extra, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_branch(branch, list, create, clone, rename, protect, unprotect, delete, cleanup, describe, merge, force, extra);
        }
        Commands::Export { patch, branch, dir, patch_suffix, extension, numbered, template, stdout, diff_opt, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_export(patch, branch, dir, patch_suffix, extension, numbered, template, stdout, diff_opt);
        }
        Commands::Patches { path, branch, diff, diff_opt, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_patches(path, branch, diff, diff_opt);
        }
        Commands::Completion { subcommand, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_completion(subcommand);
        }
        Commands::Undo { number, hard, color, .. } => {
            let cm = color.as_deref().unwrap_or(global_color);
            let _ = cm;
            do_undo(number, hard);
        }
        Commands::Redo { number, hard, color, .. } => {

            do_redo(number, hard);

        Commands::Hide { .. } => {

        Commands::Unhide { .. } => {

            eprintln!("command not implemented in this simplified clone");
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }
}

fn print_version(short: bool, color_mode: &str) {
    // need to respect color mode? original version output has no colors even with --color=always (observed no escape). So just ignore.
    if short {
        println!("stg 2.5.5");
    } else {
        println!("Stacked Git 2.5.5");
        println!("Copyright (C) 2005-2025 StGit authors");
        println!("This is free software: you are free to change and redistribute it.");
        println!("There is NO WARRANTY, to the extent permitted by law.");
        println!("SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only");
        // git version
        let git_ver = run_git_output(&["--version"]).unwrap_or_else(|_| "git version unknown".to_string());
        println!("{}", git_ver.trim());
    }
}

fn run_git(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
    let status = Command::new("git").args(args).status().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if status.success() { Ok(()) } else { Err(format!("git {:?} failed", args)) }
}

fn run_git_output(args: &[&str]) -> Result<String, String> {

    let parents: Vec<&str> = out.trim().split_whitespace().collect();
    if parents.is_empty() {
        return Err("no parents".to_string());
    }
    let p1 = parents[0].to_string();

fn read_stack_json(branch: &str) -> Result<(StackJson, String, String), String> {
    // returns stackjson, stacks_tip, metadata_commit
    let tip = get_stack_tip_commit(branch)?;
    let out = run_git_output(&["log", "-1", "--pretty=%P", &tip])?;
    let parents: Vec<String> = out.trim().split_whitespace().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
    if parents.is_empty() {
        return Err("no parent".to_string());
    }
    let meta_commit = parents[0].clone();
    // get stack.json blob oid via ls-tree
    let ls = run_git_output(&["ls-tree", &meta_commit])?;
    // parse
    let mut stack_blob_oid = None;
    for line in ls.lines() {
        if line.contains("stack.json") {
            // format: 100644 blob <oid> stack.json
            let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split_whitespace().collect();
            if parts.len() >= 3 {
                stack_blob_oid = Some(parts[2].to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    let oid = stack_blob_oid.ok_or("stack.json not found")?;
    let content = run_git_output(&["cat-file", "-p", &oid])?;
    let stack: StackJson = serde_json::from_str(&content).map_err(|e| format!("json parse error: {} content={}", e, content))?;
    Ok((stack, tip, meta_commit))
}

fn write_stack_json(stack: &StackJson) -> Result<String, String> {
    let json_str = serde_json::to_string_pretty(stack).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    // write blob
    // Use git hash-object -w --stdin
    let mut child = Command::new("git").args(&["hash-object", "-w", "--stdin"]).stdin(Stdio::piped()).stdout(Stdio::piped()).spawn().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    {
        use std::io::Write;
        let stdin = child.stdin.as_mut().ok_or("no stdin")?;
        stdin.write_all(json_str.as_bytes()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    let out = child.wait_with_output().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if !out.status.success() {
        return Err(String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr).to_string());
    }
    let oid = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
    Ok(oid)
}

fn do_init(branch_opt: Option<String>) {
    let branch = match branch_opt {
        Some(b) => b,
        None => get_current_branch().unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }),
    };
    // Check if stack exists
    if stack_ref_exists(&branch) {
        eprintln!("error: stack already initialized for branch `{}`", branch);
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let head = get_current_head_commit().unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); });
    // Create stack.json
    let stack = StackJson {
        version: 5,
        prev: None,
        head: head.clone(),
        applied: vec![],
        unapplied: vec![],
        hidden: vec![],
        patches: BTreeMap::new(),
    };
    let json_blob = write_stack_json(&stack).unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); });
    // patches tree empty
    let patches_tree = "4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904";
    let tree = create_tree_with_stack_and_patches(&json_blob, Some(patches_tree)).unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); });
    // Create metadata commit
    let meta_commit = git_commit_tree(&tree, &[], "initialize").unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); });
    // Create stacks tip merge commit with parents meta and head
    let stacks_tree = tree.clone(); // same tree?
    // Actually stacks tip tree should be same as meta tree? In observed earlier, S0 tree was same as P0 tree (which contained stack.json and empty patches). We have that.
    let stacks_commit = git_commit_tree(&stacks_tree, &[meta_commit.clone(), head.clone()], "initialize").unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("error: {}", e); std::process::exit(1); });
    // Update ref
    let refname = format!("refs/stacks/{}", branch);
    let status = Command::new("git").args(&["update-ref", &refname, &stacks_commit]).status().unwrap();
    if !status.success() {
        eprintln!("error: failed to update ref");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}
